senses.zh_definition: 沃特尼：英语姓氏，在马来语文本中用作人名的一部分，或依上下文指某位姓氏持有人。
senses.en_definition: An English surname, used as a proper noun to identify a person or family.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai sebahagian daripada nama seseorang atau untuk merujuk kepada keluarga berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 通常写作Watney，首字母大写；仅凭输入无法确定具体人物、角色或机构。没有DBP词目依据，马来语释义为说明性编写。未核实规范读音、音节和爪夷文，相关字段保留null。排名沿用输入；以下为示范组合，未经频率验证。姓氏资料参见[Ancestry所引《英国姓氏简明牛津词典》](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/watney?geo-lang=en-US)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Nama keluarga Watney hendaklah dieja dengan tepat dalam semua dokumen rasmi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有正式文件均须准确拼写Watney这一姓氏。
dual_scenarios.en: The surname Watney must be spelled correctly in all official documents.

dual_scenarios.zh: 他姓Watney吗？我就想核对一下拼写。
dual_scenarios.en: Is his surname Watney? I just want to check the spelling.

etymology.historical_story: Watney is an English surname whose origin remains uncertain. The Concise Oxford Dictionary of Family Names in Britain suggests that it may be a later variant of Watley, but presents this as a possibility rather than an established derivation. That uncertainty matters: a surname should not acquire an invented literal meaning simply because its spelling invites imaginative splitting. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/watney?geo-lang=en-US).
